description: This PHP class file defines the class 'bugzilladbInterface', which extends 'issueTrackerInterface'. It implements methods to connect and retrieve bug issue data from a Bugzilla database, including getting issue details, statuses, and checking bug ID validity and existence. It also provides configuration templates and interface details.

classes.name: bugzilladbInterface
classes.description: A class that interfaces with a Bugzilla database to retrieve and manage bug issue data, extending issueTrackerInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the object and initializes the connection to the Bugzilla database, setting default statuses and configuration.

methods.name: getissue
methods.description: Fetches issue details from the database based on the bug ID.

methods.name: getBugStatus
methods.description: Returns the status string of a bug given its ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug with the given ID exists in the database.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID follows the correct syntax/format.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns an XML template for configuring the interface.
